A reaction scheme starting with **T** is shown. Reaction 2 occurs in the presence of a catalyst; knowledge of the mechanism for this reaction is not required.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Give the reagent(s) and conditions for reaction 1.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: State and explain how 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNPH) can be used to detect the presence of **V** as a product of reaction 2.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text:
The progress of reaction 2 can be monitored by infrared spectroscopy.

The absorption caused by O-H bonds is always present because water is used as a solvent.

Identify two absorptions, and the bonds responsible for these absorptions, whose appearance will change significantly during the reaction.

parts.text:
**V** and **W** are colourless and soluble in water.

State what you would observe in reaction 3.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text:
Reaction 3 is a redox reaction.

Identify which of the **reactants** is reduced in this reaction.

parts.label: (e)(iii)
parts.text:
Construct an equation for reaction 4.

Use [H] in the equation to represent an atom of hydrogen from $\text{NaBH}_4$.

parts.text:
Both optical isomers of **X** can be dehydrated to form a single product, **Y**.

Give the reagent(s) and conditions required for reaction 5.

parts.text:
**Y** can form an addition polymer **Z**.

Draw one repeat unit of **Z**.
